prompts.paloma: Create a transparent PNG sprite animation sheet for a cartoon pixel-art pigeon in a game. Reference image only for identity/style: use ONLY the pigeon from row four, gray body, teal-purple neck, orange eye and orange feet. No humans, guinea pigs or other characters. SIX full-body frames in a precisely spaced 3 columns by 2 rows grid, each complete inside its cell with generous transparent margins, no overlap, no text. Same head size, torso proportions and 3/4 view facing right in every frame. Frame order reading left to right: 1 crouch preparing takeoff wings half folded, 2 wings lifted high with anatomically connected shoulders and bent elbows, 3 strong downstroke wings extending downward and outward feet leaving ground, 4 airborne wings horizontal broad primary feathers, 5 airborne recovery wings bent upward, 6 wings lifted overhead ready for next downstroke with feet tucked. Each frame has ONLY ONE anatomically correct pair of wings, no extra folded wings painted on torso, no pasted wing shapes. Wing coverts blend naturally into shoulder. Crisp dark pixel outlines, clustered muted gray feather shading consistent with existing reference; limited palette, no vector look, blur, glow, motion trails, ground shadows or background. Align torso center within each equal-sized cell. This is production game sprite art, natural bird flight anatomy, not a poster.
prompts.cuy: Production game sprite sheet. Use ONLY guinea pig Cuy Supremo from row three of reference atlas (brown-white guinea pig with red-white Peruvian neckerchief), preserving its face, short legs and cartoon pixel art style. SIX COMPLETE full-body guinea pigs, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows with equal cells, wide TRANSPARENT empty gutters, no overlap. Pixel art dark outlines, grouped shading, not realistic, no blur. Reading order: 1 anticipatory crouch with bent hind legs, 2 push-off extending hind legs and front paws reaching, 3 airborne tucked paws at apex, 4 airborne reaching front paws to land, 5 landing compression with all paws under body, 6 recovered proud standing squeak. Face right in three-quarter view in every pose, same head/body scale and neckerchief markings. Preserve natural guinea pig anatomy, do not turn into a bear or human. Actual alpha transparency everywhere outside each animal; NO backdrop, glow, gradient, shadows, floor, text or particles. Do not paint any shadow around the animals. Keep every complete animal in its own cell and align torso centers consistently.
